leak_needles: "EO 11812 (Oct. 1, 1974, 'shall take effect October 1, 1974'; 39 FR 36307-36312) adjusts for members of the uniformed services the monthly basic pay (Sec. 1 tables), basic allowance for subsistence (Sec. 2) and basic allowance for quarters (Sec. 3), caps basic pay at Executive Schedule level V under 5 U.S.C. 5308 (Sec. 4), supersedes seven earlier uniformed-pay orders (Sec. 5) and sets its effective date (Sec. 6). It has no term of its own; its rates govern until the next adjustment. EO 11883 (signed Oct. 6, 1975) sec. 5 supersedes 'Executive Order No. 11812 of October 1, 1974', and its sec. 2 replacement rates for basic pay, subsistence and quarters 'shall be effective on October 1, 1975' (sec. 4). Every clause except Sec. 5 therefore first ended on 1975-10-01, the stated effective date in the acting instrument (the displacement was retroactive from that date to Oct. 6). Sec. 5's supersession of earlier orders was completed when the order issued on 1974-10-01 (spent). Whole-order end = 1975-10-01. All of this order concerns the uniformed services, so the agency-specific civilian pay-period dates in EO 11883 sec. 4 do not affect it. Counterevidence: the U.S. Code note under 37 U.S.C. 1009 states that EO 11812 'which provided for the adjustment of pay rates effective Oct. 1, 1974, was superseded by Ex. Ord. No. 11883' (history, not a predicate); the 1989 Codification row reads 'Superseded by EO 11883'. savings_residuals.quote:
Sec. 2. Pay and Allowances For Members of the Uniformed Services. 
Pursuant to the provisions of section 1009 of title 37 of the United States 
Code, the rates of monthly basic pay (37 U.S.C. 205(a)), the rates of 
basic allowances for subsistence (37 U.S.C. 402), and the rates of basic 
allowances for quarters (37 U.S.C. 403 (a )) are adjusted, as set forth at 
Schedule 4 attached hereto and made a part hereof, for members of the 
uniformed services.
savings_residuals.reason: EO 11883 sec. 2 adjusts again, from Oct. 1, 1975, the same uniformed-services rates of monthly basic pay, basic allowance for subsistence and basic allowance for quarters; the adjustment function under 37 U.S.C. 1009 continues under EO 11883, and pay and allowances accrued at this order's rates for periods before Oct. 1, 1975 remain due as accrued entitlements. EO 11883 has no other savings clause. The supersession of seven earlier orders by sec. 5 of this order is a completed result not undone. No continuing effect rests on this order.
